GO_ONTOLOGY (item 9): new module-level helpers uniprot_accession(token), with_from_names_other_protein(with_from, symbol, symbol_map) and obo_descendants(parents, root) (strict descendants). parse_gaf gained keyword-only options; the new checks run AFTER the existing guards (taxon last), so the default counters are unchanged and the new counters exist only when the option is on. excluded_term_roots drops each root AND its descendants; parse_gaf raises ValueError if roots are given without descendants_of, or drop_with_from without a map. GoIndex.build keeps the original default parse_gaf call byte-identical. When leak_pruning is set it RE-PARSES the GAF with the filters (an insert-only constraint: the original call line could not be edited); cost is a few seconds on the pruning path only. The ValueError 'leak_pruning requires with_from_symbol_map' is raised before any file access. meta['leak_pruning'] = {with_from_human_protein, excluded_term_roots, accession_map_size, gaf_stats}; meta['gaf_stats'] is the pruned stats too.
LEAK_PRUNING (item 10): API as in design 1.1, plus lexicon_to_json/lexicon_from_json, entries_in_text, find_entry_spans, view_prefix, strip_view_prefix and read_protein_texts.
  Masking: both passes detect spans on the ORIGINAL text. Pass (a) looks up alnum runs; pass (b) enumerates whole-word spans inside whitespace-free chunks against `special`, equivalent to a longest-first regex alternation but linear. Overlaps resolve leftmost-longest, and a self-owned span shadows shorter entries inside it. DEVIATION from a literal sequential two-pass replace: an alnum entry inside a longer special entry (e.g. HLA inside HLA-A) masks the whole special entry instead of leaving '[GENE]-A'.
  Ownership covers ALL of a symbol's aliases (filtered or not), so a protein never masks its own names. Alias candidates exclude strings that are primary symbols.
  human_accession_map takes GAF UniProtKB col2->col3 (first wins), then fills from STRING UniProt_AC. other_db_symbol_map keys are 'HGNC:<n>' (sources containing hgnc_id, case-insensitive) and 'ENSEMBL_GeneID:<ENSG>' (source Ensembl_gene).
BUILD_PRUNED_FEATURES (item 11): module attrs EXPECTED_COUNTS, LEAK_PRUNING, SPLIT_PARAMS, SPLIT_FILES, BULK_FILES are read at call time, so tests monkeypatch them.
  verify_raw checks every RAW_SHA256 file and requires each bulk file used to be one of them. When --reference-splits is the real one, the reference test sha is asserted == REFERENCE_TEST_SHA256.
  Extra outputs: out-converted/mask_lexicon.json ({params, owner: entry->sorted owners}) and mask_manifest.json (incl. lexicon_sha256); convert_manifest go_index_cache points at the new pkl. frozen_hashes.json has every design 1.4 key (raw = {abs path: sha}).

  (b) = (a) or any mask_lexicon entry owned by one side occurring whole-word in the other side's text.
  (d) d_other_db / d_complexportal are on kept BP rows; d_complex_name is a regex on 'component of the ... complex'.
